title: Buccaneers vs. Packers: Final injury report for Week 4

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Packers: Final injury report for Week 4
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers released their final injury report Friday ahead of Sunday’s Week 4 matchup against the Green Bay Packers, and four players have officially been ruled out. Quarterback Baker Mayfield will miss the game with the right thumb injury he suffered last week against the Minnesota Vikings, leaving rookie Jalon Daniels in line […]
